hero.title: Fund the projects moving Senegal forward.
hero.intro: Discover documented local projects, run by verified people, and concretely follow the planned use of funds and their progress.
hero.note: Every contribution is recorded and can be tracked from your personal area.
hero.imageAlt: Tailor in his workshop in Dakar

published.title: Published projects
published.intro: Each listing presents the need, location, beneficiaries and planned use of the funding.
published.empty: Campaigns will be displayed here as soon as the service is available.

contribJourney.title: Contribution journey
contribJourney.text: Choose an amount, confirm your contribution and immediately find its status in your personal history.

homepage.title: A clear journey, from idea to follow-up
homepage.intro: Jappandale guides each project through four simple steps, with transparency as a guiding principle.

create.title: Present the project
create.text: Describe the need, beneficiaries, budget and planned steps.

verify.title: Get the file verified
verify.text: Identity, activity and campaign information are reviewed before publication.

mobilize.title: Mobilize contributors
mobilize.text: Share the public page and follow the fundraiser's progress with full clarity.

report.title: Report back
report.text: Manage your fundraisers and publish news about milestones reached.

verified.title: What « verified project » means
verified.intro: Validation doesn't guarantee the project's success. It confirms that the project owner submitted the requested documents and that the campaign's information was reviewed before publication.

identity.title: Identity and activity
identity.text: The project owner submits their supporting documents. The team verifies the file before any publication.

project.title: Project and funding need
project.text: The amount, use of funds, beneficiaries and timeline are reviewed.

publication.title: Controlled publication
publication.text: The campaign is only visible after validation. A rejection must be explained and corrected.

trust.title: What Jappandale checks — and what it doesn't promise.
trust.intro: Trust comes from accurate information, traceable decisions and honest communication about the service's limits.

identity.title: Checked identity
identity.text: A campaign is only published after verifying the project owner's required documents and a manual file review.

budget.title: Visible budget
budget.text: Beneficiaries, planned use of funds, timeline and updates remain accessible on the project page.

promises.title: Measured promises
promises.text: Verification confirms the file's consistency; it guarantees neither the project's success nor a financial return.

contributions.title: Traceable contributions
contributions.text: Every contribution is linked to a reference and remains viewable from the member's personal history.

reports.title: Reviewed reports
reports.text: Any member can submit a confidential report. It is kept and processed from the back office.

transparency.title: Transparency at every step
transparency.text: The statuses of campaigns, verifications and contributions remain accessible in their respective areas to make tracking each operation easier.
